title: Enterprise Endpoint Security: EPP, EDR & XDR Defense Lab

steps.title: Endpoint Agent & Telemetry Health Verification
steps.description: Construct an endpoint monitoring daemon script simulating EPP/EDR heartbeat telemetry, process interception, and cloud management check-in.
tasks: Implement a health check checking local agent status, PID, and cloud connectivity
Make it executable: `chmod +x /home/student/edr_agent.sh` and run it

verification.command: test -x /home/student/edr_agent.sh && /home/student/edr_agent.sh && grep -q 'HEALTHY_TELEMETRY_ONLINE' /home/student/edr_status.log && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Automated Host Network Isolation Simulation (CrowdStrike API)
steps.description: Build an automated incident containment script that simulates calling the EDR host containment API to isolate a compromised host while preserving analyst triage telemetry.
tasks: Simulate sending a JSON containment command: `{"action": "contain", "host_id": "srv-prod-01", "reason": "Ransomware_Behavior_Detected"}` to `/home/student/containment_audit.json`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/contain_host.sh && /home/student/contain_host.sh && grep -q 'Ransomware_Behavior_Detected' /home/student/containment_audit.json && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Storage Encryption & BitLocker/LUKS Policy Enforcement
steps.description: Formulate a policy script auditing disk encryption algorithms (XTS-AES 256-bit) and key escrow verification.
tasks: Verify volume mount encryption policy and export `ENCRYPTION_CIPHER=XTS-AES-256` to `/home/student/encryption_report.txt`

verification.command: test -x /home/student/audit_encryption.sh && /home/student/audit_encryption.sh && grep -q 'XTS-AES-256' /home/student/encryption_report.txt && echo PASS || echo FAIL
